scenes.text: It was Monday morning. Nick, Tin, and Fax walked into their classroom. "Good morning, Miss Wilson!" said the boys. "Good morning, everyone!" replied their teacher.
The boys sat down at their desks. Miss Wilson smiled. "Today, we are going to learn different ways to greet people in English."
The three boys raised their hands excitedly. They already knew some English greetings. Together, they shared three examples: Hello! Hi! Hey!
"Very good!" said Miss Wilson. "We can also say good morning, good afternoon, and good evening. But greetings can also be questions!"
Fax quickly raised his hand. "I know some!" he said excitedly. Miss Wilson smiled. "Go ahead, Fax!"
Fax stood up and started speaking. "How are you? How's it going? What's up? And when we meet someone for the first time, we can say: Nice to meet you!"
Miss Wilson gave Fax a thumbs-up. "Excellent, Fax! Well done, everyone!" The boys had learned ten different English greetings. Learning English was easier and more fun when they did it together.
